objectives.statement: Identify the personal, material and territorial scope of Law 39/2015.
Distinguish the purposes of the Common Administrative Procedure Law from the legal-regime rules of the public sector.
Identify the entities included in the concept of public administration for the purposes of Law 39/2015.
Explain the administrative capacity of minors in proceedings when the law permits it without a representative.
Identify who is an interested party in an administrative procedure.
Apply the rule for successors in title when the interested party dies or is declared missing.
Identify the cases in which several interested parties may act through a common representation.
Distinguish the means by which representation may be proved in an administrative procedure.
Explain the consequences of a representation defect and the period for curing it.
Identify the rights of interested persons in an administrative procedure.
Apply the interested person's right to know the procedure's status and its effects.
Identify the persons required to interact electronically with public administrations.
Explain when a natural person may change the channel through which they interact with the Administration.
Distinguish electronic identification from electronic signature under the administrative procedure rules.
Identify the general language rule for administrative proceedings and the effects of using a co-official language.
Apply the interested person's right to obtain copies of documents in the procedure.
Identify the duty of the interested person to provide data and documents already held by the Administration.
Explain the conditions under which an interested person may refuse to provide documents.
Identify the right to comply with obligations using the official electronic payment systems where applicable.
Distinguish the interested person's right to act with assistance from mandatory representation.
